12474.name: Woody Marks
12474.reason: Concussion in Wk10; stayed in protocol and was ruled out for Wk11. One preview gives him a chance to return Wk12; not cleared yet.

5859.name: A.J. Brown
5859.reason: Hamstring injury in Wk10 in Munich, then NE's Wk11 bye. Sleeper lists him Doubtful for Wk12 vs LAC.

11655.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
11655.reason: On IR (hamstring) since Oct 28, so Wk13 vs SF is the earliest return. No practice-window news was found.

12489.name: RJ Harvey
12489.reason: On IR (knee) since Oct 31, so Wk13 is the earliest return. No newer update was found.

2133.name: Davante Adams
2133.reason: Ruptured hamstring with surgery on Oct 18 and a 6-10 week timeline. He is on IR, and no newer update was found.

8151.name: Kenneth Walker III
8151.reason: Groin; missed Wk10 and Wk11 and was not practicing; KC plays again on Thanksgiving, a short week.

8154.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
8154.reason: Hamstring; on IR since Nov 7 (pre-Wk9) after a practice setback. The 4-game minimum (Wk9,10,12,13 with the Wk11 bye) makes Wk14 his earliest return. No newer update.

11564.name: Drake Maye
11564.reason: Right ankle injury Wk10 in Munich; Schefter/Rapoport report a fracture that could end his season, AP says out indefinitely, and Vrabel doesn't expect him back after the Wk11 bye. Surgery decision is pending.

13276.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
13276.reason: Re-aggravated his right ankle in Wk10 and missed Wk11; still Questionable. NYJ bye is Wk13.

5850.name: Josh Jacobs
5850.reason: Ring-finger surgery ~Nov 13 with a 2-3 week timeline; Rapoport sees a realistic chance he returns Wk12 after GB's bye. Questionable.

4943.name: Sam Darnold
4943.reason: Quad/ribs; missed Wks 9-10, then the Wk11 bye. Practiced Nov 20 and Macdonald is 'really optimistic' he starts Wk12.

8121.name: Romeo Doubs
8121.reason: Shoulder; on IR since Oct 19 and eligible to return Wk12 after NE's bye. No activation confirmed; QB Maye is out.

8142.name: Alec Pierce
8142.reason: Heel; on IR since Sept and rehabbing without surgery. His 21-day practice window has not opened per the latest reports (Steichen, early Nov), and there is no timetable.

11604.name: Brock Bowers
11604.reason: Ankle/quad from Wk10; did not practice early in Wk11 week and did not play Wk11. Day-to-day, still Questionable; LV bye is Wk13.

10236.name: Dalton Kincaid
10236.reason: Thumb/ankle; missed practice the week of Wk11 and did not play. Still Questionable.

13346.name: Denzel Boston
13346.reason: Toe; Questionable coming out of CLE's Wk11 bye. No practice news found.
13346.source: Sleeper status in the Nov 25 MCP snapshot; no newer news found

12490.name: Bhayshul Tuten
12490.source: Sleeper status in the Nov 25 MCP snapshot; no newer news found

7002.name: Juwan Johnson
7002.reason: Hamstring; played Wk11 but scored 0 and is listed Questionable. Reports conflict on severity.

6806.name: J.K. Dobbins
6806.reason: Listed Out (personal) and scored 0 in Wk11. No public detail on the absence.
6806.source: Sleeper status in the Nov 25 MCP snapshot; no newer news found
